rule: **Rust**: no module prefix: `Type#method` (impl and trait methods), free functions bare; module paths keep `::` (`std::env::var`); `Type::assoc` → `Type#assoc`. | `crate::` paths and the package's own crate name resolve like module paths.
notes: Layout: src/ (the scan root) holds a Cargo package, Cargo.toml plus src/*.rs, so module paths are crate-relative. Free functions are bare even inside `mod util` (clamp, helper); util::clamp and crate::util::clamp both resolve to the one definition (C1). `use std::env` makes env::var the std path std::env::var, medium (named statically, not in the scan). String::from → String#from (Type::assoc, no module prefix), medium. `use` is not a call. call_type: SPEC lists direct|method without defining them; this corpus uses method for every callee of the form Type#m / recv.m / .m (including path calls Type::assoc()) and direct for free functions, module-path functions and named nested functions.
